title: 台北捷運文湖線~Taipei Metro Wenhu Line
focus: 膠輪中運量自動運轉與高架站介面~Automated medium capacity operation and elevated station interfaces
summary: 以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。~Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 rolling_power=109.08 kW；單元 2 得 jerk=0.2970297 m/s^3；單元 3 得 dwell=24.60417 s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 coefficient 的擾動測試，結果改為 119.988 kW；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives rolling_power=109.08 kW; unit 2 gives jerk=0.2970297 m/s^3; unit 3 gives dwell=24.60417 s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing coefficient in the first unit changes its result to 119.988 kW. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：1996 年：木柵線開始營運形成後續文湖線基礎；2009 年：內湖線通車並與既有路段連接營運。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以文湖線的都市中運量路網為背景，建立密站距、曲線與高架車站的縮尺營運實驗。課程從輪胎接觸和乘客舒適性延伸到進路互鎖及失去通訊後的安全狀態，對照班距縮短與折返瓶頸。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 1996: The Muzha line opened as a predecessor of the Wenhu line; 2009: The Neihu line opened and connected with the existing route. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Wenhu urban corridor to construct a scaled operational experiment with closely spaced stations, curves and elevated platforms. Begin with tyre contact and passenger comfort, then investigate route interlocking and the safe state after communication loss. Contrast shorter line headways with a terminal that cannot release routes quickly enough. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散~Rubber-tyre rolling loss
units.title: 膠輪滾阻與熱耗散~Rubber-tyre rolling loss
units.mechanism: 膠輪變形造成遲滯能量損失，可用等效滾動阻力係數乘法向力估計阻力。胎壓、溫度和路面狀態都會改變係數；承載輪與導向輪的功能不同，不能用鋼輪系統的固定係數直接替代。 滾動阻力係數乘法向荷重得到阻力，再乘速度才是功率。輪胎壓力、溫度與變形影響係數；此模型沒有計入導向輪、風阻與加速能量，不能代表整車總耗電。 用相同輪載與速度比較輪胎滾動阻力功率，另列導向輪的功能。~Rubber deformation creates hysteretic energy loss, represented approximately by a rolling coefficient times normal force. Tyre pressure, temperature and running surface change the coefficient. Load-bearing and guidance wheels serve different functions, so a coefficient from a steel-wheel system cannot simply be substituted. Rolling-resistance coefficient times normal load gives force, and multiplying by speed gives power. Tyre inflation, temperature and deformation influence the coefficient. Guidance wheels, aerodynamic drag and acceleration are excluded, so this does not represent total vehicle electricity. Compare tyre rolling-resistance power at equal wheel load and speed, separately identifying guide-wheel functions.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s；計算：rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW。敏感度：coefficient 單獨增加百分之十至 0.013332 1，其餘固定，結果為 119.988 kW。模型邊界：固定等效係數與定速；不含轉彎側滑、胎溫演化或驅動損失。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.01212 1; normal=600000 N; speed=15 m/s; calculation: rolling_power=coefficient*normal*speed/1000=109.08 kW. Sensitivity: coefficient, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.013332 1, with all other inputs fixed, gives 119.988 kW. Model boundary: Fixed effective coefficient and constant speed; curve scrub, tyre-temperature evolution and drive losses are excluded.
units.verify: 比較相同負載下的牽引能量與胎溫，記錄胎壓、路面濕度及輪胎批次，並將導向輪磨耗獨立檢查。 在已知輪載與穩定速度下量測牽引力，記錄胎壓及溫度，扣除可辨識的其他阻力。~Compare traction energy and tyre temperature at equal load, record pressure, surface moisture and tyre batch, and inspect guidance-wheel wear separately. Measure tractive force at known normal load and steady speed, record tyre pressure and temperature, and remove identifiable other resistance.
units.failure: 胎壓偏低可能增加變形和熱累積，導向偏差又會造成額外磨耗；只看馬達電流無法區分兩種原因。 胎壓下降可能提高滾阻，需以同速同載量測判別變化。~Low tyre pressure can increase deformation and heat accumulation, while guidance misalignment adds wear; motor current alone cannot distinguish the causes. Lower inflation can raise rolling resistance; compare measurements at equal speed and load.
units.misconception: 膠輪與鋼輪的滾動阻力係數可以不經試驗直接互換~Rubber-tyre and steel-wheel rolling coefficients can be interchanged without testing.
units.practice: 改變胎壓造成的假想滾阻係數，重算同速耗能，設計同時記錄輪溫與側向磨耗的對照試驗。 再以本單元 coefficient 的對照值重算 rolling_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Change the hypothetical rolling coefficient associated with tyre pressure, recalculate energy at equal speed, and design a comparison recording tyre temperature and lateral wear. Also recalculate rolling_power for the alternative coefficient value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 加速度斜坡與舒適性~Acceleration ramps and comfort
units.title: 加速度斜坡與舒適性~Acceleration ramps and comfort
units.mechanism: 相同加速度峰值可以用不同建立時間達到，旅客感受到的突然性由加加速度描述。限制斜坡能減少站立乘客失衡，但也延長加速時間；行車時間、牽引功率及停準控制必須一起重新計算。 斜坡較緩時達到同一速度需要額外時間，且短站距可能沒有足夠時間維持最大加速度。控制器因此應以完整速度軌跡為輸出，而非只檢查單一加速度峰值。 把站立旅客的加速度斜坡與短站距加速時間一併記錄。~The same acceleration peak can be reached with different ramp durations. Jerk measures how abruptly acceleration changes. Limiting the ramp reduces sudden disturbance to standing passengers but extends acceleration time, so running time, traction power and stopping control must be reconsidered together. A gentler ramp takes more time to reach a target speed, and short station spacing may leave no interval at peak acceleration. The controller therefore needs a complete speed trajectory rather than acceptance based only on one acceleration peak. Record acceleration ramps for standing passengers together with acceleration time on short station spacing.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：a=0.9 m/s^2; ramp=3.03 s；計算：jerk=a/ramp=0.2970297 m/s^3。敏感度：ramp 單獨增加百分之十至 3.333 s，其餘固定，結果為 0.270027 m/s^3。模型邊界：線性加速度斜坡；不把此值視為任何營運者的舒適性門檻。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: a=0.9 m/s^2; ramp=3.03 s; calculation: jerk=a/ramp=0.2970297 m/s^3. Sensitivity: ramp, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 3.333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.270027 m/s^3. Model boundary: Linear acceleration ramp; the result is not an operator comfort threshold.
units.verify: 將加速度經已知頻寬濾波後再微分，保留原始資料，利用速度積分檢查濾波相位延遲沒有改變控制事件的先後。 以已知時間基準檢查取樣間隔，並比較不同濾波頻寬對加加速度峰值的影響。~Filter acceleration with a documented bandwidth before differentiating, retain raw data, and integrate it to check that phase delay has not reordered control events. Verify sampling intervals against a known time reference and compare how alternative filter bandwidths change the estimated jerk peak.
units.failure: 直接微分含雜訊的加速度會放大高頻誤差，過度平滑又會掩蓋真實尖峰；兩者都可能造成錯誤的舒適性判定。 需查看原始加速度，判別峰值是否由數值微分產生。~Differentiating noisy acceleration amplifies high-frequency error, while excessive smoothing hides real peaks; either can produce a false comfort assessment. Inspect raw acceleration to determine whether a peak was created by numerical differentiation.
units.misconception: 只要最大加速度相同乘客感受到的突然性就相同~Equal peak acceleration guarantees equal abruptness felt by passengers.
units.practice: 比較快慢兩種斜坡在同一終速度下的時間與位移，提交含濾波頻寬及感測器安裝方向的分析紀錄。 再以本單元 ramp 的對照值重算 jerk，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare fast and slow ramps at the same final speed, calculate elapsed time and distance, and document filter bandwidth and sensor orientation with the analysis. Also recalculate jerk for the alternative ramp value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 檢查小編組車門集中需求是否使某一門組決定停站尾端。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Check whether concentrated demand in a short train makes one door group govern the dwell tail.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 267至 267 persons，其餘固定，結果為 25.90625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=242 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.60417 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 267, to 267 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 25.90625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 將自動運轉的目標停車點與速度監督包絡分開表示。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Distinguish the automatic-operation target stop from the speed-supervision envelope.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=24.4 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=381.0462 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 26.84 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 477.2197 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=24.4 m/s; target=10 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=381.0462 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 26.84 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 477.2197 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證~Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
units.mechanism: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 對相向折返與側線進入建立互斥進路的真值表。~Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Construct mutually exclusive route truth tables for reversing movements and siding entry.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.
units.verify: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。~Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority.
units.failure: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。~Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well.
units.misconception: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求~Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
units.practice: 為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量~Communication delay and stale position
units.mechanism: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在無線封包延遲增加時檢查授權有效期，保留停止狀態。~A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check authority expiry as wireless packet delay grows, retaining a defined stopping state.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3333 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.3325 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.303 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.575 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3333 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.3325 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded.
units.verify: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。~Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption.
units.failure: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。~Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery.
units.misconception: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達~A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
units.practice: 把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.title: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.mechanism: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 比較一列列車換端與另一列車進入終端時的道岔占用。~A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Compare switch occupation during one train reversal with a following train entering the terminus.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 83.325 s，其餘固定，結果為 143.325 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=75.75 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=135.75 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 83.325 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 143.325 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.
units.verify: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。~Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires.
units.failure: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。~Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared.
units.misconception: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數~Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
units.practice: 畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 把最遠受電列車與同區段加速列車放入簡化供電模型。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Place the most distant receiving train and another accelerating train in a simplified supply model.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=90.9 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1666.5 A，其餘固定，結果為 99.99 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1515 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=90.9 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1666.5 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 99.99 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.title: 聲能相加與分貝~Sound-energy addition and decibels
units.mechanism: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 在高架曲線旁區分輪胎滾動、設備與背景聲能。~Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Separate tyre rolling, equipment and background acoustic energy beside an elevated curve.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB。敏感度：L1 聲級增加 3 dB，不代表數值百分比的功率增加至 74 dB，其餘固定，結果為 74.7901 dB。模型邊界：相同基準與加權的非相干聲源；不含相位干涉與背景扣除。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=71 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=72.4554 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 74 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 74.7901 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded.
units.verify: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。~Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately.
units.failure: 未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 若背景聲未扣除，不能把全部合成量歸因於列車。~Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. Without separate background measurement, the complete combined level cannot be attributed to the train.
units.misconception: 兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝~Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
units.practice: 比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.title: 備援電池與可維持時間~Backup battery endurance
units.mechanism: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 驗證失去正常電源後通訊與疏散照明的負載分配。~Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. Verify load allocation to communications and evacuation lighting after normal power is lost.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.22 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 3.9996 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.2 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.636 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.22 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3.9996 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded.
units.verify: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。~Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time.
units.failure: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。~An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve.
units.misconception: 備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間~Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration.
units.practice: 將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 4：initial=24.4 m/s，計算 transition=381.0462 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: initial=24.4 m/s, calculated transition=381.0462 m; not measured performance.
